title: Local inference on LIBR compute, and the fleet it is becoming

nodes.name: The everyday server
nodes.does: Serves the coding models on one A40 from a user-local install. No admin rights anywhere in it.
nodes.note: Serving is done; what is left on it is the walltime note in the plan's housekeeping section.

nodes.name: Up, code, down
nodes.does: Three scripts that submit the job, wait until it is really serving, and open an agent on its node.

nodes.name: The coding agent
nodes.does: opencode on the serving node, with web access denied globally and raised for one agent only.

nodes.name: The consultant
nodes.does: 744B on most of a 1 TB node, one user at a time, for work that cannot leave the building.
nodes.note: Serving is done. Two questions are open: how many KV slots, and whether MTP should be forced off.

nodes.name: The five colibri commands
nodes.does: Build, submit, ask, code and cancel. Each finds the job through squeue and steps onto its node.
nodes.note: coli-ask is the interactive one and coli-code is the overnight one: the preamble is the bill.

nodes.name: The engine
nodes.does: The int4 GLM kernel, built at a pinned commit. ARCH=native is what selects the fast path.
nodes.note: It lives outside this repository, in the Atlas checkout, and is not in git. Rebuild after a clone.

nodes.name: Keeping upstream current
nodes.does: Pulls the read-only colibri clone once a day. Never build in it; the timer expects a clean tree.

nodes.name: The measurement campaign
nodes.does: Twelve tests that decide the fleet's shape. Ten have passed and fifteen findings contradict the runbook.

nodes.name: The fleet
nodes.does: Three engines behind one front door, taking GPUs when free and yielding them when somebody else is blocked.
nodes.note: Designed in full in DESIGN.md and scheduled in FLEET-BUILD.md. None of it is built.
